proposals.title: Fossil fuel financing
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy ensuring the company's financing does not contribute to new fossil fuel supplies inconsistent with the IEA Net Zero Emissions by 2050 Scenario.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Special shareholder meeting improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Amend governing documents so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, replacing the current 20% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring separate Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman an independent director who was not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Board diversity resolution
proposals.topic_summary: Require that initial candidate lists for new outside director nominees include qualified diverse candidates and publish nominee skills matrices.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Conversion to public benefit corporation
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Amend the certificate of incorporation to convert the company to a public benefit corporation in light of its adoption of the Business Roundtable Statement of Purpose.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on setting absolute contraction targets
proposals.topic_summary: Issue a report setting absolute contraction targets for financed greenhouse gas emissions consistent with UNEP FI recommendations for credible net zero commitments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
